project.name: AutoC
project.description: Evolutionary neural-network controller for autonomous RC aircraft flight. Evolves NN weights for path-following and target-tracking in a lightweight simulator (validated against a CRRCSim flight-dynamics fork), then deploys trained nets to embedded hardware (Seeed XIAO BLE Sense).

nodes.name: claude.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that runs Claude Code on issues and pull requests whenever a comment, review, or issue body mentions '@claude'. Checks out the repo and invokes the anthropics/claude-code-action with the Anthropic API key.
nodes.languageNotes: Single job gated by a multi-clause if-condition matching '@claude' across four event types (issue_comment, pull_request_review_comment, pull_request_review, issues); uses id-token: write for OIDC.

nodes.name: Checkout repository
nodes.summary: Checks out the repository at fetch-depth 1 using actions/checkout@v4 so the Claude Code action has the source tree available.

nodes.name: Run Claude Code
nodes.summary: Invokes anthropics/claude-code-action@beta with the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret to let Claude respond to the triggering issue or pull-request mention.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Auto-generated agent development guidelines aggregating active technologies, project structure, build commands, and recent feature-plan changes for the autoc codebase.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview describing the AutoC evolutionary NN controller, its components (autoc, minisim, crrcsim, renderer, nnextractor, nn2cpp, xiao), build instructions, configuration, repo layout, and AWS/S3 checkpoint integration.

nodes.name: autoc.ini
nodes.summary: Primary runtime configuration for the evolution engine: GP/population parameters, NN mutation and init settings, lexicase selection, path-generation, wind/entry/rabbit-speed variation ramps, fitness scaling, and S3 storage.
nodes.languageNotes: INI key=value with inline comments documenting per-run experimental deltas (rnn1/rnn2/rnn3, M1 baseline tuning).

nodes.name: autoc-tracker.ini
nodes.summary: Tracker-mode evolution configuration that replays a recorded source-run dump (TrackerSourceRun) as the tracking target; mirrors autoc.ini M1 baseline hyperparameters with tracker-specific path/wind subset and variation toggles.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest config (261 lines); Mode=tracker drives source-run playback rather than synthetic rabbit paths.

nodes.name: autoc-eval.ini
nodes.summary: Fixed-evaluation configuration for deterministic regression/ablation scoring of a trained genome, holding variations fixed so cross-run fitness comparisons are valid.

nodes.name: autoc-eval-tracker.ini
nodes.summary: Fixed-evaluation configuration for tracker-mode genomes, scoring a trained tracker against a recorded source run under fixed conditions.

nodes.name: autoc-eval-visual.ini
nodes.summary: Evaluation configuration tailored for VTK renderer playback/visualization of a trained controller's flight, producing visual eval output rather than headless scoring.

nodes.name: COORDINATE_CONVENTIONS.md
nodes.summary: Authoritative reference for AutoC/crrcsim coordinate frames, axis/unit conventions, quaternion and Euler sign conventions across the INAV/msplink boundary, gyro/accel processing, and the 54-float tracker-mode NN input layout, with bench-verified contracts.
nodes.languageNotes: Long-lived contract doc with VERIFIED-bench annotations and explicit eom01.cpp / msplink.cpp line citations; serves as the cross-component source of truth for frame transforms.

nodes.name: INAV_BLACKBOX.md
nodes.summary: Field-by-field convention reference for the INAV blackbox CSV format, covering timestamp, navigation state, attitude/quaternion emission, gyro/accel/mag units, RC and actuator channels, and decoder gotchas.

nodes.name: aircraft_tracker_handoff.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive design handoff for the IR LED beacon aircraft tracker, spanning detection scheme, hardware/lens/FPGA selection, LED driver design, the FPGA DSP pipeline (CCA, blob tracking, code correlation), I2C register map, and sim-to-real considerations for the evolved-NN consumer.
nodes.languageNotes: Forward-looking architecture spec with explicit decided-vs-open sections, latency/resource budgets, and a glossary; the contract is the pose_history output abstraction feeding the control NN.

nodes.name: failsafe-behavior-audit.md
nodes.summary: Safety audit of the autoc failsafe chain (RC-dropout scenarios, MSP-override interaction, failsafe_recovery_delay semantics) with risk analysis, latent-bug assessment, and pre-flight-test recommendations.

nodes.name: inav-signal-path-audit.md
nodes.summary: Audit of the INAV signal path tracing NN-output to servo in MANUAL mode, raw gyro to MSP2_INAV_LOCAL_STATE, MSP scheduling/latency, and candidate escape-hatch architectures for lower-latency NN control.

nodes.name: sensor-pipeline.md
nodes.summary: End-to-end sensor pipeline doc from INAV MSP export through Xiao NEU→NED conversion, origin offset, NN input computation, NN output to RC commands, and the 030/032 tracker-mode 54-float input vector with CEP-gating and identity-stable beacon slotting.

nodes.name: sim-to-real-analysis.md
nodes.summary: Reusable sim-vs-flight comparison analysis (rate magnitudes, control authority, output and bank-angle distributions, tracking quality) with a units reference and method, anchored to a hb1-adjust4 gen-249 vs manual-flight case study.

nodes.name: variation-prng.md
nodes.summary: Operator guide to the variation PRNG architecture: master-seed contract, autoc-side init chain, per-scenario sub-PRNG derivation, append-only freeze contract, determinism (D-contracts), and reproducibility/replay recipes.

nodes.name: crrcsim-visual.sh
nodes.summary: CRRCSim worker launcher invoked by the autoc threadpool, starting a sim instance on DISPLAY :1 with the eval config (autoc_config-eval.xml) for visual/eval runs.
nodes.languageNotes: Per-worker launch wrapper passing BASE/INSTANCE/PORT and exporting AUTOC_WORKER_INDEX; pins DISPLAY for headed rendering.

nodes.name: crrcsim.sh
nodes.summary: CRRCSim worker launcher invoked by the autoc threadpool, starting a sim instance on DISPLAY :2 with the standard training config (autoc_config.xml).
nodes.languageNotes: Near-identical sibling of crrcsim-visual.sh; differs in DISPLAY target and the CRRCSim -g config file used.

nodes.name: eval_suite.sh
nodes.summary: Automated regression evaluation harness for trained NN weights, generating per-tier eval INIs and running tier 0-3 scenarios (repro, quick, generalization, stress) with aggregated pass/fail summaries.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses set -euo pipefail; builds eval configs by copying autoc-eval.ini and sed-patching keys so all NN topology/slew settings stay present. autoc-eval.ini is the single source of truth for sigmas.

nodes.name: make_eval_ini
nodes.summary: Generates a complete eval INI by copying the base eval config, patching the NN weights path, and applying scenario-specific key=value overrides (last-write-wins).

nodes.name: run_eval
nodes.summary: Runs a single eval scenario: stages the overlay INI, invokes autoc in eval mode, captures logs, and extracts fitness results into the per-scenario results directory.

nodes.name: run_tier0
nodes.summary: Executes the tier-0 exact-seed reproduction eval, which must match the stored training fitness bitwise as the regression gate.

nodes.name: run_tier1
nodes.summary: Runs the tier-1 quick aero-standard eval (5 paths x 49 winds) against a novel seed to check baseline generalization.

nodes.name: run_tier2
nodes.summary: Runs tier-2 generalization evals across progressive, long, and random path scenarios with varied wind seeds.

nodes.name: run_tier3
nodes.summary: Runs the tier-3 stress eval at 120% sigmas plus a quiet no-variation baseline scenario to probe robustness boundaries.

nodes.name: rebuild-perf.sh
nodes.summary: Clean optimized (PERFORMANCE_BUILD=ON) CMake rebuild of autoc + crrcsim, used as the FP-deterministic regression-gate build.
nodes.languageNotes: set -ex for traced fail-fast execution; wipes and recreates build/ for a clean configure.

nodes.name: rebuild.sh
nodes.summary: Clean debug (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug) CMake rebuild of autoc + crrcsim for interactive development.
nodes.languageNotes: Debug counterpart of rebuild-perf.sh; produces different fitness numbers than the optimized build by design.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Developer guide for the XIAO BLE Sense co-processor firmware, covering PlatformIO compilation, WSL debugging, INAV integration settings, and converting INAV blackbox logs for Google Earth visualization.

nodes.name: TODO.md
nodes.summary: Outstanding work items for the XIAO firmware: pre-arm safety checks (RC failsafe/disarm, RTH-triggered disarm), expanding the MSP status bitfield beyond 32 bits, and speeding up logfile downloads.

nodes.name: inav-bench.cfg
nodes.summary: INAV flight-controller full dump for the bench-test configuration (MAMBAF722 target, INAV 8.0.0), defining timer overrides, output assignments, PID tuning, modes, and feature flags used for ground testing the autoc co-processor integration.
nodes.languageNotes: INAV CLI dump format: a flat sequence of `batch start` ... settings commands restoring full flight-controller state.

nodes.name: inav-hb1.cfg
nodes.summary: INAV flight-controller full dump for the HB1 airframe configuration (MAMBAF722 target, INAV 8.0.0), defining the in-flight timer, output, PID, mode, and feature settings for the live aircraft running the autoc NN controller.
nodes.languageNotes: INAV CLI dump format: a flat sequence of `batch start` ... settings commands restoring full flight-controller state.

nodes.name: platformio.ini
nodes.summary: PlatformIO build configuration for the Seeed XIAO BLE Sense co-processor firmware, defining nRF52 environments, ArduinoBLE/ArduinoEigen dependencies, hard-float FPU flags, and a build_src_filter that pulls in shared NN evaluator and sensor-math sources.
nodes.languageNotes: build_src_filter cross-includes ../../src/nn/evaluator.cc and ../../src/eval/sensor_math.cc so the embedded target shares the simulator's NN inference code.

nodes.name: GP_SENSOR_ANALYSIS.md
nodes.summary: Postflight analysis comparing GP sensor-angle conventions between CRRCSim/GP training (gp_evaluator_portable.cc) and the Xiao-GP flight system (msplink.cpp), verifying velocity/position vector handling and diagnosing path-offset root causes.
nodes.languageNotes: Deeply nested markdown (4 heading levels, 29 sections) cross-referencing C++ source locations and flight-log samples.

nodes.name: PATH_GENERATOR_COMPARISON.md
nodes.summary: Side-by-side comparison of the training path generator (pathgen.h) versus the embedded flight path generator (embedded_pathgen.h), flagging a critical circle-center calculation bug and analyzing path-origin offset and flight-dynamics root causes.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with annotated code excerpts and emoji-tagged severity callouts (critical-bug, potential-issue).

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Entry-point overview for the Flight 24 (2025-12-21) postflight analysis, summarizing the coordinate fix, data sources, test spans, RC/GP-input parity results, and generated charts.

nodes.name: .gitmodules
nodes.summary: Git submodule manifest registering the project's vendored dependencies (e.g. crrcsim) as nested repositories.

nodes.name: autoc.h
nodes.summary: Top-level autoc constants and scenario descriptor structs (entry safe-zone radius/altitude bounds, WindScenarioConfig, ScenarioDescriptor) shared across the evaluation pipeline.
nodes.languageNotes: 033 cleanup removed windSeed from scenario structs in favor of per-class PRNG seeds.

nodes.name: aircraft_state.h
nodes.summary: Core simulation state model: defines Path, PathProvider hierarchy, AircraftState (full kinematic + command + NN sensor state with error history), and the PhysicsTraceEntry record used for training-trace dumps.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy getter/setter API surface over a single mutable state object; minisimAdvanceState integrates a lightweight physics step.

nodes.name: arena.h
nodes.summary: Defines the FlightArena cylindrical bounds and helpers (checkArenaBounds, arenaEgressToCrashReason) that detect and classify out-of-bounds egress during evaluation.

nodes.name: backend.h
nodes.summary: Abstract ControllerBackend interface with a pure-virtual evaluate(AircraftState, PathProvider) entry point implemented by NN/PID controller variants.

nodes.name: beacon_config.h
nodes.summary: Cereal-serializable BeaconConfig struct describing the target beacon's emission cone geometry used by the camera/perception model.

nodes.name: camera_config.h
nodes.summary: Cereal-serializable CameraConfig struct (projection model, FOV, frame rate, latency) parameterizing the simulated on-board camera sensor.

nodes.name: camera_projection.h
nodes.summary: Camera/beacon perception model: BeaconObservation, AirframeProxy, and ProjectionInput types plus the default HB1 airframe proxy, projecting target beacon into camera-frame observations.

nodes.name: crash_hull.h
nodes.summary: Defines the CrashHull collision volume (shape + radius), CrashHullShape enum, and predicates isInsideHull / didCrashFire used for probabilistic crash detection between aircraft and target.

nodes.name: derived_features.h
nodes.summary: Pure feature-engineering helpers (compute_smoothness_factor, compute_pair_span, compute_tilt / TiltSinCos) deriving NN input features from raw aircraft/target state.

nodes.name: eval_logger.h
nodes.summary: EvalLogger interface declaring per-step, per-generation, and best-controller logging hooks for evolution telemetry and NN weight stats.

nodes.name: fitness_computer.h
nodes.summary: FitnessComputer class with ScoreTerms breakdown and streak tracking, accumulating per-tick objective terms into a scenario fitness score.

nodes.name: fitness_decomposition.h
nodes.summary: Result/diagnostic types for fitness analysis: EvalResults, TrackerDiag, and ScenarioScore capturing per-scenario decomposed fitness components.

nodes.name: pathgen_stepper.h
nodes.summary: PathgenStepper implementation of the ScenarioStepper interface that advances a generated rabbit-path scenario one tick at a time.

nodes.name: pathgen.h
nodes.summary: Trajectory generation library: GeneratorMethod hierarchy (GenerateRandom, GenerateClassic, etc.), cylinder sampling and cubic interpolation helpers, and generateSmoothPaths producing seeded training rabbit paths.
nodes.languageNotes: Strategy pattern via virtual GeneratorMethod::method; deterministic mt19937 seeding for reproducible paths.

nodes.name: scenario_meta_apply.h
nodes.summary: Inline applyVariationScale helper that scales ScenarioMetadata fields by a ramp factor to implement the variation-curriculum ramp.

nodes.name: scenario_stepper.h
nodes.summary: Abstract ScenarioStepper interface (initScenario/stepOnce/durationMsec) plus checkAircraftOOB shared bound-check, defining the per-scenario simulation driver contract.

nodes.name: selection.h
nodes.summary: Selection strategy declarations: SelectionMode enum, parse/to-string helpers, lexicase_select, and minimax_fitness for evolutionary parent selection.

nodes.name: sensor_math.h
nodes.summary: Declares getInterpolatedTargetPosition, computing an odometer-offset interpolated target point along a PathProvider for sensor/lead calculations.

nodes.name: source_dmp_loader.h
nodes.summary: Loader API for cereal-serialized .dmp artifacts (loadSourceDmp, loadEvalResultsDmp) plus filters for crashed and per-index source scenarios used in library-based training.

nodes.name: source_trajectory.h
nodes.summary: Defines SourceTickSample and SourceScenarioTrajectory records representing recorded flight trajectories replayed as training targets.

nodes.name: tracker_stepper.h
nodes.summary: TrackerStepper ScenarioStepper implementation driving target-tracking scenarios, projecting beacon observations, shifting NN history, and counting crash-hull fires per tick.

nodes.name: trail_rabbit.h
nodes.summary: Declares computeTrailRabbit, deriving a trailing pursuit point a fixed distance behind a moving target (default 10ft) for chase-mode tracking.

nodes.name: variation_generator.h
nodes.summary: Per-scenario variation sampling: VariationSigmas/VariationOffsets, per-class PRNG draws (entry/wind), and rabbit speed-profile generation, implementing the joint-PRNG deterministic variation design.
nodes.languageNotes: Box-Muller Gaussian draws over class-partitioned PRNG streams to keep variation sampling deterministic and reproducible.

nodes.name: inav_quat_convention.h
nodes.summary: IMU coordinate-convention helper (inavQuatToAerospaceEB) converting INAV's quaternion array into the project's aerospace earth-to-body quaternion.

nodes.name: AircraftState
nodes.summary: Central mutable simulation state: kinematics (position/velocity/orientation), control commands, wind, rabbit target, gyro rates, NN sensor data, error history, and a minisim physics-advance step.

nodes.name: Path
nodes.summary: A single rabbit-path waypoint record with sanitize and dump helpers for serialization/inspection.

nodes.name: PathProvider
nodes.summary: Abstract base for path access providers exposing current index, path size, and max-distance queries.

nodes.name: PhysicsTraceEntry
nodes.summary: Per-tick physics/NN trace record capturing the full set of sensor inputs and control outputs for training-trace dumps.

nodes.name: minisimAdvanceState
nodes.summary: Lightweight kinematic integration step advancing aircraft state by one tick without the full CRRCSim FDM.

nodes.name: resetHistory
nodes.summary: Resets the NN error/target history buffer to a clean initial state at scenario start.

nodes.name: BeaconObservation
nodes.summary: Camera-frame observation of the target beacon (visibility, bearing/elevation, projected position) consumed as NN perception input.

nodes.name: defaultAirframeProxyHB1
nodes.summary: Returns the default HB1 airframe proxy geometry used as the camera mount reference for projection.

nodes.name: compute_smoothness_factor
nodes.summary: Computes a control-smoothness factor from recent command deltas, used both as an NN feature and a fitness term.

nodes.name: compute_tilt
nodes.summary: Derives the aircraft tilt as a sin/cos pair (TiltSinCos) for continuous NN input encoding.

nodes.name: ScenarioScore
nodes.summary: Per-scenario decomposed fitness score holding individual objective components used by lexicase/minimax selection.

nodes.name: TrackerDiag
nodes.summary: Tracking-mode diagnostic aggregate (in-ramp time, visibility, hull fires) recorded per scenario for analysis.

nodes.name: FitnessComputer
nodes.summary: Accumulates per-tick objective ScoreTerms with streak tracking into a final scenario fitness value.

nodes.name: GeneratorMethod
nodes.summary: Abstract strategy base for path generators, declaring the seeded method() and a shared localRandomPointInCylinder sampler.

nodes.name: GenerateRandom
nodes.summary: GeneratorMethod producing randomized smooth cubic-spline rabbit paths within the flight cylinder.

nodes.name: GenerateClassic
nodes.summary: GeneratorMethod producing the classic parametric (cosine-based) figure path used as a baseline rabbit trajectory.

nodes.name: ScenarioStepper
nodes.summary: Abstract per-scenario simulation driver interface (initScenario, stepOnce, durationMsec) implemented by pathgen and tracker steppers.

nodes.name: PathgenStepper
nodes.summary: ScenarioStepper implementation that drives a generated rabbit-path-following scenario tick by tick.

nodes.name: TrackerStepper
nodes.summary: ScenarioStepper for target-tracking scenarios: steps physics, projects beacon observations, shifts NN history, and counts crash-hull fires.

nodes.name: SourceScenarioTrajectory
nodes.summary: A recorded source flight trajectory (sequence of SourceTickSample) replayed as a training target in library-based training.

nodes.name: generateVariations
nodes.summary: Draws a full set of per-scenario VariationOffsets from a seeded PRNG using Box-Muller Gaussian sampling over the configured sigmas.

nodes.name: generateSpeedProfile
nodes.summary: Generates a time-keyed rabbit speed profile (RabbitSpeedPoint sequence) with stochastic variation for per-scenario target dynamics.

nodes.name: inavQuatToAerospaceEB
nodes.summary: Converts an INAV-convention quaternion array into the project's aerospace earth-to-body quaternion.

nodes.name: math_utils.h
nodes.summary: Backward-compatible inline math wrappers (GPrandGaussian, GPrandDouble) that delegate to the rng:: namespace; marked for removal once callers migrate.
nodes.languageNotes: Thin inline delegation header preserving legacy GP-prefixed call sites.

nodes.name: evaluator.h
nodes.summary: Core NN-controller interface: defines the NNGenome weight container, recurrent telemetry/history structures, and the NNControllerBackend that drives a forward pass per simulation tick.
nodes.languageNotes: Holds the raw byte-format TrackerHistoryWindow buffer used for recurrent NN inputs.

nodes.name: mode.h
nodes.summary: Declares the ModeStrategy abstraction with a gather_inputs function pointer that selects how NN sensor inputs are assembled (path-following vs tracker mode).

nodes.name: nn_input_computation.h
nodes.summary: Small inline helper header providing computeTargetDir, which derives the normalized direction vector to the target used as an NN sensor input.

nodes.name: nn_inputs.h
nodes.summary: Defines the NN sensor input schema: the NNInputs/TrackerInputs structs and SensorInputMeta metadata describing the 33-element input vector fed to the controller network.

nodes.name: population.h
nodes.summary: Declares NNPopulation (the evolving genome pool) and NNEvolveParams (mutation/selection hyperparameters) for the genetic NN evolution loop.

nodes.name: serialization.h
nodes.summary: Declares the NN01 binary format (magic bytes, version) and the nn_serialize / nn_deserialize / nn_detect_format functions for persisting NNGenome weights.

nodes.name: telemetry.h
nodes.summary: Defines PopulationBlockStats and related per-generation telemetry aggregates emitted during NN evolution for monitoring fitness and weight statistics.

nodes.name: topology.h
nodes.summary: Compile-time NN architecture constants: layer sizes (33,32,16r,3), recurrence flags, derived weight/hidden-state counts, and the topology string used for serialization.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses constexpr-derived weight counts so the topology is a single source of truth at compile time.

nodes.name: crash_reason.h
nodes.summary: Defines the CrashReason enum plus inline isCrash and crashReasonToString helpers used to classify and report simulation termination causes over RPC.

nodes.name: protocol.h
nodes.summary: Central RPC wire protocol: defines ControllerType/Mode enums and the cereal-serialized WorkerInit, EvalData, EvalResults, DebugSample and related message structs exchanged between the parent and evaluation workers.
nodes.languageNotes: Custom cereal serialize functions in the cereal namespace; schema grows without bumping cereal version per project policy.

nodes.name: scenario_metadata.h
nodes.summary: Defines ScenarioMetadata, carrying per-scenario seeds and variation parameters so workers can deterministically reconstruct a flight scenario.

nodes.name: types.h
nodes.summary: Shared scalar and Eigen type aliases (gp_scalar float, gp_vec3, gp_quat, gp_fitness double) with portable Eigen includes for desktop and Arduino builds.
nodes.languageNotes: float for the eval hot path, double (gp_fitness) for fitness accumulation.

nodes.name: config.h
nodes.summary: Defines the AutocConfig struct (all tunable run parameters) and the ConfigManager that parses autoc.ini into it for the evolution/eval pipeline.

nodes.name: logger.h
nodes.summary: Lightweight logging facility: LogLevel enum, an ostream-derived LogStream, and a Logger class providing level-filtered streaming log output.

nodes.name: rng.h
nodes.summary: Thread-local Mersenne-Twister RNG namespace providing seed/randInt/randDouble/randGaussian/randomPercent, seeded from class-scoped scenario PRNGs for determinism.

nodes.name: scenario_prng.h
nodes.summary: Hierarchical deterministic PRNG: MasterPRNG, ScenarioRootPRNG, and ClassPRNG derive class-scoped sub-seeds (ClassSubSeeds) so each variation axis samples independently and reproducibly.
nodes.languageNotes: Layered seed-derivation design enforcing the per-scenario joint-sample determinism invariant.

nodes.name: socket_wrapper.h
nodes.summary: RAII TCP networking primitives: TcpSocket (connect/read/write) and TcpAcceptor (bind/listen/accept) wrapping POSIX sockets for the parent-worker RPC transport.

nodes.name: threadpool.h
nodes.summary: Header-only ThreadPool that runs worker threads dispatching evaluation jobs over RPC sockets, with task queueing and wait_for_tasks synchronization.

nodes.name: autoc.cc
nodes.summary: Main driver of the AutoC trainer: orchestrates NN evolution and evaluation, builds WorkerInit/EvalData RPC payloads, manages deterministic scenario variation generation, logs EvalResults, and hosts the program entry point.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest TU in the batch; couples evolution loop, scenario PRNG seeding, S3 dmp logging, and the worker thread pool.

nodes.name: arena.cc
nodes.summary: Flight-arena geometry helpers computing the smallest positive ray-boundary intersection and distance-to-boundary for out-of-bounds and crash detection.

nodes.name: camera_projection.cc
nodes.summary: Simulated camera sensor: projects a tracked beacon into the FOV, applies proxy ray occlusion and quantized CEP noise, and emits sentinel observations when the beacon is not visible.
nodes.languageNotes: CEP placeholder is a linear off-axis approximation pending motion-blur/sensor-noise realism.

nodes.name: crash_hull.cc
nodes.summary: Crash-hull detection: tests whether the aircraft is inside the collision hull and uses a seeded LCG to probabilistically fire crash events for hull penalties.

nodes.name: eval_logger.cc
nodes.summary: Thin evaluation-logging shims (logStep, logGenerationStats, logBestController, logNNWeightStats) forwarding per-tick and per-generation telemetry.

nodes.name: fitness_computer.cc
nodes.summary: Implements FitnessComputer: computes and decomposes per-step tracking scores and applies streak bonus/reset logic to shape the evolution fitness signal.

nodes.name: NNGenome
nodes.summary: Container for a neural-network controller's evolvable weights and metadata, serving as the genome unit of the genetic algorithm.

nodes.name: NNControllerBackend
nodes.summary: ControllerBackend implementation that runs the recurrent NN forward pass each tick, mapping sensor inputs to pitch/roll/throttle outputs.

nodes.name: ModeStrategy
nodes.summary: Strategy struct holding a gather_inputs function pointer that selects the NN input-assembly behavior for the active flight mode.

nodes.name: computeTargetDir
nodes.summary: Computes the normalized direction vector from the aircraft to the target, used as an NN sensor input.

nodes.name: NNInputs
nodes.summary: Struct defining the path-following NN sensor input vector layout consumed by the controller network.

nodes.name: TrackerInputs
nodes.summary: Struct defining the tracker-mode NN sensor input vector, including camera-projected beacon and span/tilt sensor fields.

nodes.name: isCrash
nodes.summary: Returns whether a given CrashReason value represents an actual crash termination.

nodes.name: ScenarioMetadata
nodes.summary: Carries per-scenario seeds and variation parameters so a worker can deterministically reconstruct the same flight scenario.

nodes.name: TcpSocket
nodes.summary: RAII wrapper over a POSIX TCP socket providing connect, blocking read/write, and fd lifecycle management for RPC transport.

nodes.name: TcpAcceptor
nodes.summary: RAII TCP listening socket that binds a port and accepts incoming worker connections, returning TcpSocket instances.

nodes.name: ThreadPool
nodes.summary: Header-only thread pool whose workers pull evaluation jobs and dispatch them over RPC sockets, with task queueing and wait_for_tasks barrier.

nodes.name: worker
nodes.summary: Worker-thread loop that dequeues evaluation tasks and runs them against a connected RPC worker socket.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Program entry point: parses CLI/ini config and dispatches to NN evolution or evaluation, wiring up the worker thread pool and logging.

nodes.name: runNNEvolution
nodes.summary: Drives the generational genetic-algorithm loop: evaluates the population over scenarios, selects, mutates, logs telemetry, and checkpoints best controllers.

nodes.name: runNNEvaluation
nodes.summary: Runs a fixed evaluation pass of a controller over the scenario set, dispatching EvalData jobs to workers and aggregating EvalResults.

nodes.name: buildWorkerInit
nodes.summary: Assembles the WorkerInit priming RPC payload (config, topology, scenario tables) sent once to each worker before per-eval jobs.

nodes.name: buildEvalData
nodes.summary: Builds the per-evaluation EvalData RPC message carrying the genome and scenario selection for a worker to run.

nodes.name: logEvalResults
nodes.summary: Formats and writes per-generation EvalResults telemetry, including fitness decomposition and per-axis control statistics.

nodes.name: logEvalResultsScenarioTracker
nodes.summary: Tracker-mode variant of EvalResults logging that records per-scenario tracking metrics and camera/beacon observations.

nodes.name: rebuildGenerationScenarios
nodes.summary: Deterministically reconstructs the scenario set for a generation from scenario seeds and variation parameters.

nodes.name: prefetchAllVariations
nodes.summary: Pre-generates and caches all scenario variation offsets up front so evaluation is reproducible and avoids per-eval payload bloat.

nodes.name: populateVariationOffsets
nodes.summary: Fills per-scenario variation offset tables from class-scoped PRNG samples for deterministic craft/wind/camera variation.

nodes.name: computePathFrame
nodes.summary: Computes an orthonormal path frame (tangent/normal/binormal) along a trajectory segment for path-following geometry.

nodes.name: distanceToBoundary
nodes.summary: Computes the distance from a point along a direction to the flight-arena boundary, used for out-of-bounds detection.

nodes.name: smallestPositiveRoot
nodes.summary: Returns the smallest positive root of a quadratic, used to find the nearest ray-boundary intersection.

nodes.name: projectBeacon
nodes.summary: Projects a tracked beacon into the simulated camera FOV with occlusion and quantized CEP noise, producing the tracker observation or a sentinel when not visible.

nodes.name: rayHitsProxy
nodes.summary: Tests whether a camera ray to the beacon is occluded by the aircraft proxy geometry.

nodes.name: isInsideHull
nodes.summary: Tests whether the aircraft position falls inside the collision crash hull volume.

nodes.name: didCrashFire
nodes.summary: Probabilistically determines whether a crash event fires via a seeded LCG, used to apply hull crash penalties.

nodes.name: decomposeStepScore
nodes.summary: Breaks a per-step tracking score into its component terms for fitness decomposition and telemetry.

nodes.name: applyStreak
nodes.summary: Applies streak-based bonus shaping to the accumulating fitness when consecutive good-tracking steps occur.

nodes.name: config.cc
nodes.summary: Global runtime configuration singleton: parses the INI file and provides shared parameters and the S3 client.

nodes.name: logger.cc
nodes.summary: Minimal logging translation unit defining shared logger state.

nodes.name: scenario_prng.cc
nodes.summary: Deterministic hierarchical PRNG (master/scenario/class) providing reproducible per-scenario randomness, including Gaussian sampling.

nodes.name: arena_tests.cc
nodes.summary: GoogleTest suite for arena/AGL geometry and chase-state helpers.

nodes.name: beacon_projection_tests.cc
nodes.summary: GoogleTest suite validating beacon/camera projection math and visibility geometry.

nodes.name: cereal_version_anchor_tests.cc

layers.name: Evolution Engine & Population

layers.name: Evaluation & Simulation
layers.description: Lightweight minisim arena, path/trajectory generators, scenario steppers, crash-hull, fitness computation/decomposition, selection, and dmp-source trajectory loading that drive each candidate's flight evaluation.

layers.name: Neural Network Core
layers.description: NN topology, inference mode, weight serialization (cereal), and telemetry for the evolved controller networks.

layers.name: Perception & Sensors
layers.description: Camera projection/config, beacon geometry, sensor math, IMU quaternion conventions, and derived-feature/NN-input computation that turn world state into network inputs.

layers.name: RPC & Transport
layers.description: Parent-worker wire protocol, scenario metadata payloads, and crash-reason codes for distributed evaluation.

layers.name: Utilities & Config

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand what AutoC is: an evolutionary system that breeds neural-network controllers for autonomous RC aircraft. It introduces the full pipeline — the autoc trainer, the minisim and CRRCSim simulators, the VTK renderer, the nn2cpp exporter, and the XIAO embedded target — plus build, configuration, and S3 checkpoint conventions. Read this first to get the map for everything that follows.

tour.title: The Evolution Engine Entry Point
tour.description: src/autoc.cc is the main driver and program entry point. It orchestrates the core loop the README described: it builds RPC payloads (WorkerInit/EvalData), generates deterministic scenario variations, drives NN evolution across generations, and logs EvalResults. Notice how it pulls in nearly every subsystem header — this file is the hub from which the rest of the tour radiates outward.
tour.languageLesson: C++17 here leans on RAII and header-only Eigen for math; the trainer is a long-lived process that fans evaluation work out to worker threads via an RPC protocol rather than calling the simulator inline.

tour.title: Shared Types and Vocabulary
tour.description: Before diving into subsystems, learn the project's shared vocabulary. types.h defines the scalar and Eigen aliases used everywhere — gp_scalar (float) for sim state, gp_fitness (double) for scores, and gp_vec3/gp_quat for geometry. These aliases enforce a deliberate float-vs-double discipline (fitness must accumulate in double) that recurs throughout the fitness and evolution code.
tour.languageLesson: Centralizing numeric types behind aliases lets the same code compile for desktop and Arduino targets and makes the float/double precision contract explicit rather than accidental.

tour.title: Population and Genetic Evolution
tour.description: This is the genetic algorithm at the heart of the system. population.h declares NNPopulation (the evolving pool of genomes) and NNEvolveParams (mutation/selection knobs), and population.cc implements the operators: initialization, arithmetic crossover, Gaussian mutation, and tournament selection. Each generation, the trainer from Step 2 scores the population and these operators produce the next one.

tour.title: The Neural-Network Core
tour.description: evaluator.h and evaluator.cc are the NN itself. The header defines NNGenome (the weight container being evolved) plus the recurrent telemetry/history structures; the implementation runs feedforward and recurrent forward passes, gathers inputs each tick, and turns sensor state into pitch/roll/throttle commands. This is the genome that population.cc from Step 4 mutates and selects on.
tour.languageLesson: The recurrent path keeps a hidden state across ticks, letting the network build an internal predictor of target motion — important because the controller is trained on past-only inputs with no lookahead.

tour.title: Persisting Genomes (NN01 Format)
tour.description: A genome is only useful if it can be saved, checkpointed to S3, and later exported to hardware. serialization.h defines the NN01 binary format (magic bytes, version) with nn_serialize/nn_deserialize/nn_detect_format. This is the bridge between the trainer (Step 2), the cereal-based checkpoints the README mentioned, and the nn2cpp exporter you'll see in Step 11.

tour.title: Stepping a Scenario
tour.description: How does one genome get scored against a flight? ScenarioStepper is the abstract per-scenario simulation driver (initScenario/stepOnce/durationMsec) with a shared out-of-bounds check. TrackerStepper is the concrete target-tracking implementation: it projects beacon observations, shifts the NN's history each tick, and counts crash-hull fires. Each tick it calls the evaluator from Step 5 and advances the simulated aircraft.

tour.title: Building the World: Paths and Arena
tour.description: Scenarios need targets to chase and bounds to stay within. pathgen.h is the trajectory library — the GeneratorMethod hierarchy plus cylinder sampling and cubic interpolation that produce seeded training 'rabbit' paths. arena.h defines the cylindrical FlightArena and the checks that detect and classify out-of-bounds egress, feeding crash reasons back into the stepper from Step 7.

tour.title: Scoring Flight: The Fitness Function
tour.description: This is what evolution optimizes. fitness_computer.h accumulates per-tick objective terms (track accuracy, smoothness) with streak tracking into a single scenario score, while fitness_decomposition.h provides the diagnostic types — EvalResults, TrackerDiag, ScenarioScore — that break a score back into its components for analysis. The selection in Step 4 ranks genomes by exactly these numbers.

tour.title: Perception: Simulated Camera and Sensors
tour.description: The tracker doesn't get the target's true position for free — it sees it through a simulated sensor. camera_projection.cc projects the tracked beacon into the field of view, applies occlusion and quantized CEP noise, and emits sentinel observations when the beacon isn't visible. sensor_math.h computes the interpolated, odometer-offset target point used for lead calculations. This is the input that feeds the NN's history in Step 7.

tour.title: Determinism: Config and the Variation PRNG
tour.description: Reproducibility is non-negotiable here. config.h defines AutocConfig and the ConfigManager that parses autoc.ini into every tunable run parameter. scenario_prng.h implements the hierarchical deterministic PRNG (MasterPRNG → ScenarioRootPRNG → ClassPRNG) so each variation axis samples independently yet reproducibly. The variation-prng doc is the operator's guide to the master-seed contract and replay recipes.
tour.languageLesson: A seed hierarchy gives independent, append-only random streams per variation axis — adding a new axis can't perturb existing ones, which is what makes bit-exact replay within a build possible.

tour.title: The Tooling: Simulate, Visualize, Export
tour.description: Three standalone tools wrap the core engine. minisim.cc is the lightweight harness that scores a genome without the full CRRCSim FDM for fast iteration. renderer.cc is the VTK 3D visualizer that draws flight tapes, FOV pyramids, and control overlays for playback. nn2cpp.cc closes the loop, converting a serialized NN01 genome into portable C++ for the embedded target.

tour.title: Trusting the System: The Test Suite
tour.description: A large GoogleTest suite locks down the contracts you've just toured. The evaluator tests check forward-pass outputs and RNN hidden-state handling, the fitness tests pin the scoring math, and the PRNG tests guard the determinism contract from Step 11. These tests are the regression gate that keeps numerically sensitive evolution reproducible across changes.

tour.title: Deployment: Embedded Firmware and Postflight
tour.description: Finally, the trained net flies on real hardware. xiao/src/main.cpp is the Arduino firmware entry point wiring setup/loop to the control loop; msplink.cpp bridges INAV MSP state into an AircraftState, runs the NN, and writes back RC commands with NED/NEU conversions; flash_logger.cpp records every flight to QSPI flash. The Flight 24 postflight README closes the loop, comparing real flight data against simulation to validate the sim-to-real fidelity the whole pipeline depends on.
tour.languageLesson: Coordinate-frame bugs are the dominant sim-to-real hazard: msplink converts between INAV's NED/NEU conventions, and the postflight analysis exists specifically to catch the kind of axis/sign mismatches documented in COORDINATE_CONVENTIONS.md.
